summary: Completed comprehensive testing of multi-page PDF preview and download features. All 14 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed - page count badges, multi-page preview with navigation arrows, page indicator, page dots, and blob download button all working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend preview endpoint correctly supports ?page=N query parameter (0-indexed)
Backend returns 404 for out-of-range page numbers (both negative and beyond page_count)
Backend file download endpoint correctly returns Content-Disposition: attachment header
Backend generates preview images on-the-fly via fallback path when pre-stored previews don't exist
Frontend correctly displays page count badges (e.g., '12 pages', '4 pages') for multi-page PDFs
Frontend preview container has proper data-testid='preview-container-{id}'
Frontend page navigation buttons have data-testid='prev-page-{id}' and 'next-page-{id}'
Frontend page dots have data-testid='page-dot-{id}-{pagenum}' for each page
Frontend correctly shows 'Page X of Y' text indicator for multi-page documents
Frontend single-page documents correctly show NO navigation arrows or page indicator
Frontend download uses fetch+blob pattern for cross-device compatibility
Frontend touch swipe handlers implemented with 50px threshold for mobile navigation
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing documents: Operating Agreement (12 pages), LLC Company Authorization Resolution (4 pages), Bank account agreement (2 pages), Bank Account Details (2 pages), Final Letter (1 page)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-page preview and download features fully tested. Key data-testids: preview-container-{id}, preview-img-{id}, prev-page-{id}, next-page-{id}, page-dot-{id}-{pagenum}, download-doc-{id}. The preview endpoint supports ?page=N (0-indexed). Download endpoint returns Content-Disposition: attachment header. Single-page documents correctly hide navigation UI. Page dot navigation allows jumping to any page directly.
